events.title: Planet No More Demo Update Announcement
events.summary: Hi everyone! It’s been a while since our last update, and we’re sorry for the silence! Development has continued behind the scenes, and we’re finally back with some exciting news: we’ve just released a major demo update for Planet No More on Steam! As we get closer to Steam Next Fest, we wanted to bring the demo up to speed with some of the new content we’ve added since the initial release. The first one is now fully functional, and it's designed specifically around your most direct tool: the cursor itself. events.summary: Hi everyone!We have some absolutely massive news to kick off this week's update. We officially signed a publishing deal! Planet No More will now be published in partnership with Rogue Duck Interactive and GamerSky Games, so we couldn't be more excited about this milestone. This is a huge step forward for our tiny team, and we genuinely can't wait for you to see how this partnership elevates the game. Meanwhile, the weather outside is scorching hot, our office AC is running cold, and I’m dealing with a bit of a stubborn cold myself... But the grind never stops! On top of the two existing comet types, we are currently designing and coding several brand-new variants.
